```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(modeldata)
```

## Zadanie 1

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

ames <- modeldata::ames %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

split_ames <- initial_split(ames, prop = 0.7)
train_ames <- training(split_ames)
test_ames <- testing(split_ames)

lm_spec_1 <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm")

lm_fit_1 <- lm_spec_1 %>%
  fit(Sale_Price ~ ., data = train_ames)

pred_ames <- test_ames %>%
  select(Sale_Price) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(lm_fit_1, new_data = test_ames))

pred_ames %>%
  metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq, mape)(truth = Sale_Price, estimate = .pred)
```

```{r}
pred_ames %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sale_Price, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Wartości obserwowane",
    y = "Wartości przewidywane",
    title = "Ames: observed vs predicted (test)"
  )
```

## Zadanie 2

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

auto <- ggplot2::mpg %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  select(all_of(c("displ", "year", "cyl", "cty", "hwy", "fl", "class", "trans")))

split_auto <- initial_split(auto, prop = 0.7)
train_auto <- training(split_auto)
test_auto <- testing(split_auto)

# regresja liniowa
lm_spec_2 <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm")

lm_fit_2 <- lm_spec_2 %>%
  fit(hwy ~ ., data = train_auto)

pred_lm_auto <- predict(lm_fit_2, new_data = test_auto) %>%
  bind_cols(test_auto %>% select(hwy)) %>%
  mutate(model = "lm")

# model 2: kNN
knn_spec_reg <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = 15) %>%
  set_engine("kknn") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

knn_rec_reg <- recipe(hwy ~ ., data = train_auto) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

knn_wf_reg <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(knn_rec_reg) %>%
  add_model(knn_spec_reg)

knn_fit_reg <- knn_wf_reg %>% fit(data = train_auto)

pred_knn_auto <- predict(knn_fit_reg, new_data = test_auto) %>%
  bind_cols(test_auto %>% select(hwy)) %>%
  mutate(model = "knn")

pred_auto_all <- bind_rows(pred_lm_auto, pred_knn_auto)

pred_auto_all %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq_trad, ccc)(truth = hwy, estimate = .pred) %>%
  arrange(.metric, .estimate)
```

## Zadanie 3

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

chicago <- Chicago %>%
  select(ridership, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  drop_na()

split_chi <- initial_split(chicago, prop = 0.7)
train_chi <- training(split_chi)
test_chi <- testing(split_chi)

# model 1: regresja liniowa
lm_spec_3 <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm")

lm_fit_3 <- lm_spec_3 %>%
  fit(ridership ~ ., data = train_chi)

pred_lm_chi <- predict(lm_fit_3, new_data = test_chi) %>%
  bind_cols(test_chi %>% select(ridership)) %>%
  mutate(model = "lm")

# model 2: drzewo regresyjne
tree_spec <- decision_tree() %>%
  set_engine("rpart") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

tree_fit <- tree_spec %>%
  fit(ridership ~ ., data = train_chi)

pred_tree_chi <- predict(tree_fit, new_data = test_chi) %>%
  bind_cols(test_chi %>% select(ridership)) %>%
  mutate(model = "tree")

pred_chi_all <- bind_rows(pred_lm_chi, pred_tree_chi)
```

```{r}
# własna miara WAPE zgodna z yardstick
wape <- function(data, ...) {
  UseMethod("wape")
}

wape <- yardstick::new_numeric_metric(wape, direction = "minimize")

wape.data.frame <- function(data, truth, estimate, na_rm = TRUE, case_weights = NULL, ...) {
  truth <- rlang::eval_tidy(rlang::enquo(truth), data)
  estimate <- rlang::eval_tidy(rlang::enquo(estimate), data)

  yardstick::check_numeric_metric(truth, estimate, case_weights)

  if (na_rm) {
    complete <- stats::complete.cases(truth, estimate)
    truth <- truth[complete]
    estimate <- estimate[complete]
  }

  estimate_wape <- if (length(truth) == 0 || sum(abs(truth)) == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    sum(abs(truth - estimate)) / sum(abs(truth)) * 100
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    .metric = "wape",
    .estimator = "standard",
    .estimate = estimate_wape
  )
}

pred_chi_all %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  group_modify(~ metric_set(rmse, mae, wape)(.x, truth = ridership, estimate = .pred))
```

## Zadanie 4

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

churn_data <- wa_churn %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(churn = forcats::fct_relevel(churn, "Yes"))

split_churn <- initial_split(churn_data, prop = 0.7, strata = churn)
train_churn <- training(split_churn)
test_churn <- testing(split_churn)

log_spec_1 <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

log_fit_1 <- log_spec_1 %>%
  fit(churn ~ ., data = train_churn)

pred_class_churn <- predict(log_fit_1, new_data = test_churn)
pred_prob_churn <- predict(log_fit_1, new_data = test_churn, type = "prob")

pred_churn <- test_churn %>%
  select(churn) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_class_churn, pred_prob_churn)

pred_churn %>%
  conf_mat(truth = churn, estimate = .pred_class)
```

```{r}
metric_set(accuracy, kap, sens, yardstick::spec, precision, recall, f_meas)(
  pred_churn,
  truth = churn,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "first"
)
```

Przy niezbalansowanych klasach `accuracy` bywa myląca, dlatego warto ją uzupełniać o `sens`, `spec`, `precision` i `f_meas`.

## Zadanie 5

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

cells_data <- cells %>%
  mutate(class = forcats::fct_relevel(class, "WS", "PS"))

split_cells <- initial_split(cells_data, prop = 0.7, strata = class)
train_cells <- training(split_cells)
test_cells <- testing(split_cells)

# model logistyczny
log_spec_2 <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

log_fit_2 <- log_spec_2 %>%
  fit(class ~ ., data = train_cells)

pred_lr <- test_cells %>%
  select(class) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(log_fit_2, new_data = test_cells)) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(log_fit_2, new_data = test_cells, type = "prob")) %>%
  mutate(model = "logistic")

# model 2: kNN
knn_spec_cls <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = 21) %>%
  set_engine("kknn") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

knn_rec_cls <- recipe(class ~ ., data = train_cells) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

knn_wf_cls <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(knn_rec_cls) %>%
  add_model(knn_spec_cls)

knn_fit_cls <- knn_wf_cls %>% fit(data = train_cells)

pred_knn <- test_cells %>%
  select(class) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(knn_fit_cls, new_data = test_cells)) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(knn_fit_cls, new_data = test_cells, type = "prob")) %>%
  mutate(model = "knn")

pred_cells_all <- bind_rows(pred_lr, pred_knn)

pred_cells_all %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  roc_auc(truth = class, .pred_PS, event_level = "second")
```

```{r}
pred_cells_all %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  pr_auc(truth = class, .pred_PS, event_level = "second")
```

```{r}
pred_lr %>%
  roc_curve(truth = class, .pred_PS, event_level = "second") %>%
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
pred_lr %>%
  pr_curve(truth = class, .pred_PS, event_level = "second") %>%
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
# porównanie progów 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 dla modelu logistycznego
threshold_eval <- function(data, thr) {
  data_thr <- data %>%
    mutate(
      class_thr = factor(
        if_else(.pred_PS >= thr, "PS", "WS"),
        levels = levels(class)
      )
    )

  tibble(
    threshold = thr,
    sens = sens_vec(data_thr$class, data_thr$class_thr, event_level = "second"),
    spec = spec_vec(data_thr$class, data_thr$class_thr, event_level = "second"),
    f_meas = f_meas_vec(data_thr$class, data_thr$class_thr, event_level = "second")
  )
}

bind_rows(
  threshold_eval(pred_lr, 0.3),
  threshold_eval(pred_lr, 0.5),
  threshold_eval(pred_lr, 0.7)
)
```

## Zadanie 6

```{r}
set.seed(2026)

peng <- modeldata::attrition %>%
  mutate(
    is_adelie = if_else(Attrition == "Yes", "Yes", "No"),
    is_adelie = factor(is_adelie, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ) %>%
  select(-Attrition)

split_peng <- initial_split(peng, prop = 0.7, strata = is_adelie)
train_peng <- training(split_peng)
test_peng <- testing(split_peng)

log_spec_3 <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

log_fit_3 <- log_spec_3 %>%
  fit(is_adelie ~ ., data = train_peng)

pred_peng <- test_peng %>%
  select(is_adelie) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(log_fit_3, new_data = test_peng)) %>%
  bind_cols(predict(log_fit_3, new_data = test_peng, type = "prob"))
```

```{r}
# standardowe metryki
metric_set(accuracy, bal_accuracy, precision, recall)(
  pred_peng,
  truth = is_adelie,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "second"
)
```

```{r}
# własna miara F2
prec <- precision_vec(pred_peng$is_adelie, pred_peng$.pred_class, event_level = "second")
rec <- recall_vec(pred_peng$is_adelie, pred_peng$.pred_class, event_level = "second")

f2 <- (1 + 2^2) * (prec * rec) / ((2^2) * prec + rec)

tibble(metric = "F2", value = f2)
```

W praktyce `F2` preferujemy wtedy, gdy ważniejsze jest ograniczenie pominięć klasy pozytywnej (większy nacisk na `recall`) niż maksymalizacja ogólnej trafności.
